entry.title: I build scalable, secure, and automated cloud infrastructure that bridges the gap between development and operations. "If you have to do it twice, automate it."
entry.summary:
I'm Rajvardhan Singh Badgujar, a passionate Cloud & DevOps Engineer and final-year BCA student from Indore, India. I specialize in building scalable, secure, and automated cloud infrastructure that bridges the gap between development and operations.
My philosophy: "If you have to do it twice, automate it." I thrive on creating CI/CD pipelines, containerized applications, and infrastructure as code that just works.
